summary.en: Vercel v0 Mini, Pro, Max and Max Fast through the official v0 Platform API.
summary.zh: 通过 v0 官方 Platform API 接入 Mini、Pro、Max 和 Max Fast。

summary.en: Gumloop with your API key and user ID: account models, streaming, tool calls and a locally calibrated credit estimate.
summary.zh: 使用 API key 和用户 ID 接入 Gumloop：按账号发现模型，支持流式响应、工具调用和本地校准的积分估算。

summary.en: Agnes AI international with Chrome browser sign-in: live OpenAI-compatible text models, Token Plan and Agent Plan usage, and the USD wallet balance.
summary.zh: 通过 Chrome 浏览器登录 Agnes AI 国际版：动态发现 OpenAI 兼容文本模型，显示 Token Plan、Agent Plan 用量与美元余额，无需手动复制会话 token。

summary.en: Unofficial AtomGit CodingPlan access for magpie and OpenCode: browser OAuth or local AtomCode CLI sign-in, signed OpenAI-compatible requests, live models, quota windows, and a read-only diagnostics page.
summary.zh: 非官方接入 AtomGit CodingPlan：支持浏览器 OAuth 或复用本机 AtomCode CLI 登录，发送签名请求，显示实时模型与额度窗口，并提供只读诊断页。

summary.en: GitHub Copilot on GitHub.com or GitHub Enterprise, with premium request or credit usage, remaining allowance and quota reset dates.
summary.zh: GitHub Copilot：支持 GitHub.com 与 GitHub Enterprise，显示高级请求或积分用量、剩余额度和重置时间。

summary.en: Unofficial JoyCode provider: JD account browser sign-in, live models and credit multipliers, plan credits and streaming tool calls.
summary.zh: 非官方 JoyCode 插件：京东账号浏览器登录，动态模型与积分倍率、套餐额度及流式工具调用。

summary.en: Not a model API: Doubao Work has none for other clients. This drives its desktop app (or Doubao's) the way a person does, so each request is one run of Doubao's cloud agent in a new task, with the client's tools asked for as text. macOS and Windows; unofficial.
summary.zh: 不是模型接口：豆包工作没有给第三方客户端用的模型接口。本插件像人一样操作豆包工作（或豆包）桌面版，每个请求是豆包云端智能体在一个新任务里的一次执行，客户端的工具以文本方式调用。macOS 和 Windows；非官方。

summary.en: Not Google's API: the Gemini web app (gemini.google.com), with your Google account signed in through a browser window of its own, or as a visitor without one. Each request is one streamed call to the app's own endpoint, in a temporary chat, with the client's tools asked for as text. Unofficial.
summary.zh: 不是 Google 的 API：Gemini 网页版（gemini.google.com），在插件自己的浏览器窗口里登录 Google 账号，或不登录以访客使用。每个请求是对网页版自己接口的一次流式调用（临时对话，不进历史），客户端的工具以文本方式调用。非官方。

summary.en: Kimi desktop Work subscription through its local sign-in, with live Work models and shared membership usage. Separate from Kimi Code.
summary.zh: 使用本机普通 Kimi 桌面版的 Work 登录，自动读取 Work 模型和会员共享用量；独立于 Kimi Code。

summary.en: OpenCode Zen's free models with the public credential, automatic discovery and native streaming protocols.
summary.zh: 使用 public 凭证接入 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，自动发现模型并支持原生流式协议。

summary.en: Z.ai and BigModel GLM Coding Plan, team seats and ZCode's free Start Plan, with a daily claim of its gift plans.
summary.zh: Z.ai 与智谱 GLM Coding Plan，支持团队席位和 ZCode 免费 Start Plan，可每日领取 ZCode 活动包。

summary.en: Your Qoder subscription: international (qoder.com), Qoder CN (qoder.cn, Alibaba Cloud or phone sign-in) or Qoder CN Teams (qoder.com.cn, the organization kept on the account), each its own provider. Also QwenWork (千问办公): the public cloud or the enterprise flagship with its own domain. Unofficial for QwenWork.
summary.zh: 用 Qoder 自己的设备登录使用 Qoder 订阅：国际版（qoder.com）、Qoder 中国版（Qoder CN，qoder.cn，阿里云账号 / 手机号登录）与 Qoder 中国版团队版（qoder.com.cn，账号带上所属组织）各是一个 provider；也接入千问办公：公有云与企业旗舰版（输入企业自己的域名）。千问办公部分非官方。

summary.en: Devin's models with your Devin account — a browser sign-in or the devin CLI's.
summary.zh: 用 Devin 账号使用 Devin 的模型：浏览器登录，或沿用 devin CLI 的登录。

summary.en: Claude, GPT, Gemini and Grok hosted by Zed, on your Zed plan.
summary.zh: 用 Zed 订阅使用 Zed 托管的 Claude、GPT、Gemini 和 Grok。

summary.en: Factory's Droid subscription: models from Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI and open labs.
summary.zh: Factory Droid 订阅：Anthropic、OpenAI、xAI 及开源模型。

summary.en: SuperGrok and X Premium+, through the Grok Build CLI's sign-in.
summary.zh: 通过 Grok Build CLI 的登录使用 SuperGrok 和 X Premium+。

summary.en: Command Code plans — Pro, GOAT, Max, Ultra, Go and Teams.
summary.zh: Command Code 各档套餐：Pro、GOAT、Max、Ultra、Go 和 Teams。

summary.en: Xiaomi MiMo models with your Xiaomi account.
summary.zh: 用小米账号使用小米 MiMo 模型。

summary.en: Cursor Pro, Pro+, Ultra and Teams — every model your plan has, with tool calls.
summary.zh: Cursor Pro、Pro+、Ultra 与 Teams：套餐里的所有模型，支持工具调用。

summary.en: Kiro Free, Pro, Pro+ and Power — Kiro's sign-in, kiro-cli's, an API key, or accounts imported by refresh token.
summary.zh: Kiro Free、Pro、Pro+ 与 Power：Kiro 登录、沿用 kiro-cli 的登录、API key，或按 refresh token 导入账号。

summary.en: MiniMax Code credits and M Plan with device sign-in, native web search, image/video generation and media tools through Magpie MCP.
summary.zh: MiniMax Code 积分与 M Plan、设备登录，提供原生网络搜索、生图、生视频及多模态 MCP 工具。

summary.en: Unofficial MiniMax Design desktop provider (China and Global): reuses your local sign-in or a pasted accessToken for live chat, native image/video models, and credit balance.
summary.zh: 非官方 MiniMax Design 桌面端供应商（中国区与国际版）：只读复用本机登录态或粘贴 accessToken，接入实时对话、原生图像/视频模型与积分余额。

summary.en: Warp (the terminal) AI request credits through the Warp app's sign-in: the auto routers and every model family the account lists.
summary.zh: 用 Warp 终端应用的登录使用 Warp AI 请求额度：auto 路由与账户可用的全部模型家族。

summary.en: WorkBuddy's China build (CodeBuddy plan) and its international build.
summary.zh: WorkBuddy 国内版（CodeBuddy 套餐）与国际版。

summary.en: Cline's models on your own Cline account — usage billing, ClinePass and Cline's free models — with Cline's device sign-in or an API key.
summary.zh: 用自己的 Cline 账号使用 Cline 的模型——用量计费、ClinePass 与免费模型——支持 Cline 设备登录或 API key。

summary.en: Trae CN (trae.cn) and Trae international (trae.ai) models with your own account, free tier included — Trae's own browser sign-in. Experimental.
summary.zh: 用 Trae CN（trae.cn）与 Trae 国际版（trae.ai）账号使用各自的模型，含免费版，使用 Trae 自己的浏览器登录。实验性。

summary.en: Open Design Cloud's Design Plan (open-design.ai): the account's device sign-in, the models the plan entitles it to, and the plan's 5-hour and 7-day allowance and wallet balance.
summary.zh: Open Design Cloud 的 Design Plan（open-design.ai）：账号设备登录、套餐可用的模型，以及 5 小时与 7 天额度、钱包余额。

summary.en: Meituan's 妙手 CatPaw (ai.catpaw.meituan.com): a browser web sign-in or the desktop client's saved credentials, chat through its round/event/turn conversation protocol, models and credit balance.
summary.zh: 美团妙手 CatPaw（ai.catpaw.meituan.com）：浏览器网页登录或妙手桌面端已保存的登录态，经其 round/event/turn 会话协议对话，含模型与积分余额。

summary.en: iFlytek's Loomy (loomyad.xunfei.cn): SMS sign-in, OpenAI-compatible chat with reasoning-effort folding and image markers, the live model catalog, two point wallets and the daily first-login grant.
summary.zh: 讯飞 Loomy（loomyad.xunfei.cn）：短信验证码登录，OpenAI 兼容对话（思考档折叠与图片标记适配），实时模型目录、双积分钱包与每日首登赠送。

summary.en: Nous Portal models, with Nous Portal's device sign-in.
summary.zh: 通过 Nous Portal 自己的设备码登录使用 Nous Portal 模型。

summary.en: SenseTime Raccoon (xiaohuanxiong.com) models, account credits and daily check-in, with browser sign-in or Raccoon desktop's live sign-in.
summary.zh: 商汤小浣熊（xiaohuanxiong.com）模型、积分余额与每日签到，支持浏览器登录或直接复用小浣熊桌面端登录态。

summary.en: SenseNova (SenseTime 日日新) Token Plan: a browser sign-in (or the console account and password) reads the credit pools, their 5-hour and 7-day windows and the expiring grants, and serves the plan's own models — the browser sign-in reuses or creates a Token Plan API key for you.
summary.zh: 商汤日日新 Token Plan：浏览器登录（或控制台账号密码）读取积分池、5 小时 / 7 天窗口与将过期的返赠余额，并直接调用计划内模型——浏览器登录会自动复用或创建 Token Plan API Key。

summary.en: Unofficial: Intern InkStone(书生·端砚) Token Plan: a browser sign-in reads the ink-credit balance, the 5-hour and 7-day windows and the credit packs, and creates an ink-* API key (or reuses a pasted one) to serve the plan's models for chat.
summary.zh: 非官方：书生·端砚（Intern InkStone）墨点计划：浏览器登录读取墨点余额、5 小时 / 7 天窗口与墨点包，并创建 ink-* API Key（或复用现有 Key）直接调用计划内模型对话。

summary.en: AutoClaw (Zhipu OpenClaw) cloud accounts: oversea web sign-in (Google/z.ai) or CN phone SMS, credit balance and daily check-in.
summary.zh: AutoClaw（智谱澳龙/OpenClaw）云端账号：国际版网页登录（Google/z.ai）或国内手机验证码，积分余额与每日签到。

summary.en: Unofficial: Huawei Cloud CodeArts (码道) coding plans and OfficeAce (AgentArts), each signed in with Huawei Cloud OAuth on its own card — GLM, DeepSeek, openPangu and OfficeAce's MaaS models, live models and credit rates, credit usage by bucket and the daily check-in. Replaces officeace-auth; accounts signed in there keep working.
summary.zh: 非官方：华为云码道（CodeArts）编码套餐与 OfficeAce（AgentArts），两张卡各自用华为云 OAuth 登录；GLM、DeepSeek、openPangu 与 OfficeAce 的 MaaS 模型，实时模型与积分倍率、分桶积分用量和每日签到。取代 officeace-auth，原已登录的账号继续可用。

summary.en: Vertex AI models and Google Cloud promotional credits, signed with your own gcloud or ADC login. Lists only the models your project can call.
summary.zh: 用本机 gcloud / ADC 登录使用 Vertex AI 模型，并读取 Google Cloud 促销赠金；只列出项目实际能调用的模型。

summary.en: Cloudflare Workers AI with your API token (Workers AI:Edit): 28+ models discovered live from models.dev, the 8 paid-only models flagged, and a Neurons/day allowance row in magpie quota.
summary.zh: 用你的 Cloudflare API Token（Workers AI:Edit 权限）登录 Workers AI：28+ 模型经 models.dev 实时发现，付费专属模型自动标注，magpie quota 显示每日 Neurons 免费额度。

summary.en: OpenAI's native Decisions API as System One for Magpie classifiers and decision groups: choice, score and boolean probabilities, with standard API-key sign-in and per-question refusal handling.
summary.zh: 将 OpenAI 原生 Decisions API 转为 System One，供 Magpie 分类器与决策模型组使用，保留选择、评分和布尔概率；使用标准 API key 登录，单题拒绝时保留其余答案。

summary.en: Magnific image and video generation with a Magnific API key: 20 native image and video models (Mystic, Nano Banana, Flux, Veo, Kling, Seedance, WAN, …) and tools that reach all 140 endpoints from every agent.
summary.zh: 用 Magnific API key 接入生图、生视频：20 个原生生图/视频模型（Mystic、Nano Banana、Flux、Veo、Kling、Seedance、WAN 等），外加每个 agent 都能调用、覆盖全部 140 个端点的工具。

summary.en: River (river.ai) pay-as-you-go inference with your API key: per-account models from /v1/models, documented reasoning efforts and live prices from River's public pricing endpoint.
summary.zh: 用你的 API key 接入 River (river.ai) 按量计费推理：按账号从 /v1/models 列出模型，带官方推理档位与实时价格。

summary.en: Existing SAP AI Core deployments with client-secret credential-file sign-in, per-resource-group GPT Responses and Claude Messages discovery, streaming and agent tools. No deployment provisioning or quota reporting; Magpie only.
summary.zh: 用本机 client-secret 凭据文件连接已有 SAP AI Core 部署：按资源组发现 GPT Responses 与 Claude Messages 模型，支持流式回复和 agent 工具。不创建部署，不报告额度；仅验证 Magpie。

summary.en: Tencent Cloud OrcaTerm (遨驰终端) AI assistant models — DeepSeek, Hunyuan, GLM, Kimi — on the account's monthly question allowance. Unofficial; the README sets out the terms.
summary.zh: 用腾讯云遨驰终端（OrcaTerm）AI 助手的模型——DeepSeek、混元、GLM、Kimi——走账号每月问答额度。非官方，条款风险见 README。

summary.en: Unofficial AStudio (iFLYTEK Astron Studio): sign in through a browser (each account gets its own pool slot), reuse the desktop sign-in, or paste a token, to serve its Responses model gateway with the live model catalog, daily login-points check-in (read from the credit ledger) and points balance with spark-point expiry. Differs from Providers Hub's hub-astudio, which signs in on a local page (SMS, password or WeChat QR) and calls chat/completions; on one account both share the same daily points pool.
summary.zh: 非官方 AStudio（科大讯飞 Astron Studio）：支持浏览器登录（每个账号占账号池一格）、复用桌面端登录态或粘贴凭据，接入其模型网关，含实时模型目录、每日登录积分签到（按积分流水判定）与积分余额/星火到期时间。与 Providers Hub 的 hub-astudio 不同：那边在本地登录页用短信、密码或微信扫码登录，走 chat/completions；同一账号两边共用一个每日积分池。

summary.en: Unofficial Agnes Code: both sites (international agnes-ai.com and China agnes-ai.cn) as two provider ids, each served by its own BFF. Sign in with a browser loopback flow on any platform, or reuse the desktop's saved session (Windows) — the session's own bffPublicBaseUrl decides which site the credential belongs to. Live model catalog, daily credit check-in and points balance per site.
summary.zh: 非官方 Agnes Code：国际站（agnes-ai.com）与国内站（agnes-ai.cn）各一个 provider id，各走自己的 BFF。登录支持浏览器 loopback 流程（三平台）或复用桌面端登录态（Windows）——会话自带的 bffPublicBaseUrl 决定这份凭据属于哪一端。两端各自有实时模型目录、每日积分签到与余额。

summary.en: Unofficial Tabbit (web.tabbit.com, and web.tabbit.ai for international accounts) provider: reuse the Tabbit Browser sign-in on this computer to serve its chat models, with the account's live catalog, cycle usage and the daily check-in. No browser automation: a turn is Tabbit's own room → run → event-stream calls. Client tool calls are not available (Tabbit's tools are its own).
summary.zh: 非官方 Tabbit（web.tabbit.com，国际版账号走 web.tabbit.ai）插件：复用本机 Tabbit 浏览器的登录态接入它的聊天模型，含账号实时模型目录、周期用量与每日签到。不走浏览器自动化：一轮对话就是 Tabbit 自己的 建房间 → 发起 → 事件流。不支持客户端工具调用（Tabbit 的工具是它自己的）。

summary.en: Unofficial MClaw provider: China Mobile Cloud's MClaw agent (ai.yun.139.com) with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint — the browser sign-in harvests the ticket by itself, auto-fetches the llm key and the token multipliers, serves the live model catalogue and the aitokens pool usage, and renews the ticket before it expires.
summary.zh: 非官方 MClaw 插件：中国移动云 MClaw 智能体（ai.yun.139.com），OpenAI 兼容接口——浏览器登录一次自动收票、自动取 llm key 与积分倍率，动态模型目录与 aitokens 池用量，凭证到期前自动续期。

summary.en: Unofficial: Antigravity's models (Gemini, and whatever else agy offers) in any agent, on your Google account. Install, then Sign in with Google in magpie; the Antigravity CLI (agy) is installed for you if this computer doesn't have it. Requests are made by agy itself, and each tool call the agent makes waits about 2 seconds for agy's own safety check.
summary.zh: 非官方：用你的 Google 账号，在任意 Agent 里使用 Antigravity 的模型（Gemini，以及 agy 开放的其它模型）。安装后在 magpie 里点「登录」用 Google 登录即可；本机没有 Antigravity CLI（agy）时会自动安装。请求由 agy 本身发出，Agent 每次调用工具要多等约 2 秒，那是 agy 自己的安全检查。

summary.en: BAILU AI (白鹿, bailucode.com) with an API key or a browser sign-in that fetches one: live models on the key, the 白鹿通行证 quota (credits, tokens, per-protocol packs) on the card, and the portal's daily check-in.
summary.zh: 接入白鹿 Open Platform（bailucode.com）：可粘贴 API key，也可用浏览器登录后自动取回账号里的 key；按 key 拉取实时模型，卡片显示通行证额度（积分、Token、定向额度），并接上门户的每日签到。

summary.en: Gemini, Claude and GPT-OSS in Antigravity, with your Google account (AI Pro, Ultra or free).
summary.zh: 用 Google 账号（AI Pro、Ultra 或免费）使用 Antigravity 里的 Gemini、Claude 和 GPT-OSS。
